class.description: ! Class to manipulate a Shape with handle.

method.description: Exchanges the TopoDS_Shape object defining this shape for another one referencing the same underlying shape Accesses the list of shapes within the underlying shape referenced by the TopoDS_Shape object. Returns a reference to a TopoDS_Shape based on this shape. The TopoDS_Shape can be modified.
